I'm Ifunanya Obiefuna, an AWS Cloud Engineer focused on building reliable, secure, and cost-conscious infrastructure for modern businesses. I work across the full AWS stack, from networking and compute to serverless architecture and storage.

My approach is grounded in the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Every decision I make whether architecting for fault tolerance, tightening IAM policies, or eliminating unnecessary spend, is intentional and tied to business outcomes.

I'm available for freelance and contract engagements, working remotely with clients globally.

Serverless URL Shortener

Built a fully serverless URL shortener on AWS with zero idle cost. A POST request generates a unique short code stored in DynamoDB and returns a live short URL. A GET request triggers Lambda to perform a 301 redirect The architecture is fully event-driven with no servers running 24/7.
